description: Train/runtime contract for fingerspelling (static letter) features. fingerspell_features.py and fingerspellFeatures.ts must implement this identically; fixture-tested like feature_spec.json.
input: 21 hand landmarks (x, y, z) from MediaPipe hand output (Holistic or HandLandmarker)

normalization.handedness: canonicalize to RIGHT hand: if the active hand is the left hand, negate x of every landmark before further normalization
normalization.scale: divide all coordinates by euclidean distance (x,y,z) from wrist (0) to middle-finger MCP (9); fallback 1.0 if < 1e-6

classes: A-Z plus 'space' and 'del' (28) — see shared/labels_fingerspell.json written by training
